market_view: The IT sector is broadly positive on AI partnership and product-launch news, with NVDA and AMD receiving the strongest sentiment and catalyst flow. AAPL faces smartphone shipment headwinds and CRM faces acquisition skepticism, while existing holdings are supported by favorable news despite small intraday P&L moves. With no clear new entry levels and a first-day mandate to trade carefully, holding current positions and waiting for clearer signals is the disciplined choice.
